Listening to Jesus.
Living Faithfully.
Waiting for His Return.

settings.editor: Teaching the Word of God. Making disciples. Helping believers hear what Christ is saying to His Ekklesia and live faithfully in His purposes.
What Jesus Is Saying to His Ekklesia
What God Is Doing While We Wait for Christ's Return

I am a disciple of Christ and do not call myself a Christian. A Christian can mean many things today, but a disciple of Christ can mean one thing: you follow Jesus Christ. That is who I am.

Because that is true, I listen to what the Holy Spirit tells me, and I do it. That has got me into some conflicts with people, and yet, when I stood my ground on what the Holy Spirit told me, it caused a shift in my soul. I no longer sought to please man, but to please God.

settings.title:
One book asks us to listen to what Jesus is saying.
The other asks us to consider what God is accomplishing while we wait.

settings.editor: Together they call the Ekklesia to hear Christ and to persevere until He comes.

The Ekklesia is more than a gathering in a building. It is the people God has called to Himself, formed through His Word, matured through discipleship, and sent to live out His purposes.

My teaching and writing are centered on helping believers understand what it means to follow Christ, mature in Him, and faithfully participate in what God is doing in the earth.
